rules.rule: For price-touch questions (crypto, oil, commodities), copy strike, venue and test (touch or candle close) from the rules, check venue candles for a prior hit, and report spot within 15 min, % to strike, days left, volatility, days of last 14 through it, dated catalysts.

If a question asks whether a named product, version or official statement appears by a date, search the exact name with 'cancel', 'delay', 'scrapped', read the past 24 hours and recent event coverage, independent reports it already happened, and the issuer's past lag.

For ceasefire or 'no strike' questions, read what counts as a breach (e.g. strikes on territory only, not ships or threats), check the latest dated conflict tracker (e.g. Critical Threats) for the last qualifying strike, and report the lull's length, days left and deployments.

For election questions, report the state's lean, recent results for the same office, cash on hand, every dated poll with pollster and sponsor, a nonpartisan-poll average, first-hand Cook/Sabato/Inside Elections ratings, other races' polls, primary turnout, national mood.

Before citing a past polling miss, check it was the same candidate and cycle type; report the nominee's own record and whether the seat is open; label partisan lean indexes, secondhand 'safe' labels, party-sponsored polls, win streaks and spending gaps as weak.

For match or fight questions, report both sides' dated absences, returns and weigh-in news, the stand-in's and absent player's recent output, settled from confirmed lineups; label head-to-heads under about 10 games, win streaks and common-opponent links as weak.

For team win, spread or total questions, report home-only and road-only records, dated scores and points allowed over each side's last 5, last 8–10 meetings, schedule strength, starting QB or key starter changes, and whether a draw resolves No; label 3–4 game streaks weak.

If a game, stage, final or ceremony began before judgment, first get its result from a source timestamped within the hour (league site, Liquipedia), dropping undated snippets; else report series wins needed, remaining rounds and opponents, or the award shortlist.

For tennis completion questions, read which endings count, report the tour level's normal-finish share and each player's recent full matches, weigh only past-week injury or withdrawal news, and after start time check Tennis Explorer or ITF for w/o or ret. first.

For NFL player props, research the named player, never team D/ST rates: for TDs, his TDs per game this and last season, red-zone carries or targets and target share; for yardage, attempts per game and games past the line; plus the opponent's rank and injured defenders.

For single MLB games, report confirmed starters' ERA, ERA+ and recent starts, each bullpen's unavailable arms (injury, leave, short rest), season and road records, and form since Sept 1; label old-roster franchise streaks and series-level rates as not single-game evidence.

For video view questions, check the channel's uploads since the question opened and report any new video's upload time, hours elapsed, views and climb rate first; build references only from first-168-hour counts of recent comparable uploads, not lifetime or undated totals.

For live-streamed challenge questions near the deadline, get the current attempt's status from the past 12 hours (stream VODs, streamers' socials, fan trackers): milestones reached, gear, deaths or resets, plus the participants' own past completions and times.

For Rotten Tomatoes score questions, read the year-specific film page named in the rules first, record the current score, review count, Certified Fresh status and dated earlier readings (festival to wide release) showing drift, and count reviews needed to cross the strike.

For reality-show elimination questions, confirm every fact names the asked contestant and their own pro partner, and report couples left, eliminations per episode, live shows in the window, and every couple's judges' scores and bottom-three history.

For cumulative box-office questions, take the latest weekend and daily totals from The Numbers or Box Office Mojo dated within 7 days of judgment, report recent weekly drop rates, and project the remaining gross to the deadline against the threshold.

For earnings-beat questions, copy the EPS basis (GAAP diluted or adjusted) and strike from the rules, report the dated consensus and recent revisions, the last 4–8 quarters' actual-versus-consensus surprise percentages, and management's dated guidance or segment commentary.

For CPI questions, get the dated consensus and Cleveland Fed nowcast, rebuild the 12-month rate from NSA index levels incl. the month dropping out, find the monthly change the strike needs, and estimate it bottom-up: gas weight × AAA/EIA change plus typical core and food.

For GDP questions, confirm the rules' threshold and measure (BEA advance estimate, annualized real growth) match the question title, then report the release date, the latest dated GDPNow and NY Fed nowcasts, each one's typical error, and recent quarters' nowcast misses.

For central-bank rate questions (Fed, BoE, ECB), take the current rate and last move from the latest statement and minutes, check the strike under the rules' exact wording, and report dated policymaker speeches since then, latest CPI, energy prices, dissents, economist polls.
